title: Sitar Legend Forever - Expert
description: Sitar Legend Forever - Expert — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A //TEMP

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 7, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Expert mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A //TEMP

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 7, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Expert mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

Expert. Say it out loud. Doesn't it just sound cool. Here, say this: 'I'm an Expert at Sitar Hero!' You know, if you say that out loud in a public setting you will have to beat the admiring fans back with a two-handed Sitar. Isn't that what you always wanted?

The teleporter to play Sitar Hero on Expert is in Mutanous Malaise, Level 7. It is guarded by some serious Sitar Hero fans, so take care. Return to me, Gee Dubya Shrub, here in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine when you have beaten Sitar Hero on Expert.

Turn-in:

You have reached the mountain top and are the envy of every Sitar Hero player in the Kingdom. You are blessed with exceptional talent that translates into absolutely nothing that will help you in the real world. Your elders must be proud! Let me know when you want to try Sitar Hero on Expert again.

Objectives:

  • 10 Polkadot Notes ×10
  • 10 Plaid Notes ×10
  • 10 Paisley Notes ×10
  • 10 Leopard Notes ×10

Client level range: 33–55
